exercises.title: Raga Yaman - Aaroh, Avroh, Pakad
exercises.description: Repeat after the teacher: Yaman scale movement, pakad, and short chalan phrases.

raga.name: Yaman
raga.notes: Uses tivra Ma. Keep the movement phrase-led rather than plain scale-only.

exercises.title: Raga Bhupali - Aaroh, Avroh, Pakad
exercises.description: Repeat after the teacher: pentatonic Bhupali with clear Re-Ga-Pa-Dha-Sa movement.

raga.name: Bhupali
raga.notes: Ma and Ni are omitted. Keep phrases open, simple, and steady.

exercises.title: Raga Durga - Aaroh, Avroh, Pakad
exercises.description: Repeat after the teacher: Durga phrases using Sa Re Ma Pa Dha with restful Ma and Sa.

raga.name: Durga
raga.notes: Ga and Ni are omitted. Phrases often lean on Ma.

exercises.title: Raga Kafi - Aaroh, Avroh, Pakad
exercises.description: Repeat after the teacher: Kafi with komal Ga and komal Ni in gentle phrase motion.

raga.name: Kafi
raga.notes: Uses komal Ga and komal Ni. Keep the descent relaxed and song-like.

exercises.title: Raga Khamaj - Aaroh, Avroh, Pakad
exercises.description: Repeat after the teacher: Khamaj with shuddha Ni in ascent and komal Ni in descent.

raga.name: Khamaj
raga.notes: Shuddha Ni appears in ascent; komal Ni is characteristic in descent.
